protocol.selection_rule: Smallest radius maximizing separation ratio between untrained and best classical, subject to the 40-70% band.

selection_rule_corrected: Eligibility first: retain cells in the 40-70% band that pass the GPS and vehicle-length floors; among them maximize separation ratio and break ties by smallest radius.

timeout_diagnostic.assessment: Expected discriminating task misses within the calibrated band; no runtime-health failure.
